description: Step 2: send the signed work request. On START the engine then makes her wallet (status requested, then active); read lounge_desk to follow it.

action.description: START, PAUSE, RESUME or STOP (the same as you signed).

companion.description: The companion's token id (a whole number).

floatCap.description: Most money her own wallet may hold, in $ZENI (1 to 20000); the rest is sent to the holder.

maxReward.description: Most she may take on one job, in $ZENI (2 to 100000).

nonce.description: The nonce from the matching *_prepare tool.

owner.description: The holder's 0x wallet (the one that owns her on chain).

signature.description: personal_sign of the exact `message` from the prepare tool, by the holder's wallet.

name: lounge_work_submit
